title: guard.verdict body v1
description: Screening result for one binary. Publisher: jv-guard. Policy (approved 2026-08-22): jv-compat FAILS CLOSED without a clean-or-overridden verdict; 'suspicious' may be overridden via the confirmation flow, 'blocked' never. Only hashes ever leave the machine (invariant 7). Envelope conf = 1.0.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons, spoken on request ('matched ClamAV signature X', 'packer entropy anomaly'). Empty for clean.

scanned_by.description: Engines that actually ran, e.g. ['clamav'] — outages are visible, not silent.
